import pathlib

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objects=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx]==color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            minr=min(y for y,x in cells); maxr=max(y for y,x in cells)
            minc=min(x for y,x in cells); maxc=max(x for y,x in cells)
            shape={(y-minr,x-minc) for y,x in cells}
            objects.append((minc,minr,color,maxr-minr+1,maxc-minc+1,shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda o:(o[0],o[1]))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    y=x=0
    for i,(_,_,color,oh,ow,shape) in enumerate(objects):
        for dy,dx in shape:
            if 0<=y+dy<h and 0<=x+dx<w: out[y+dy][x+dx]=color
        y+=oh-1; x+=ow-1
    return out

# test grid
inp=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
for r in range(6,10): inp[r][0]=7
for r in range(7,10):
    inp[r][2]=inp[r][3]=8
    inp[r][5]=6
for r in range(8,10): inp[r][7]=inp[r][8]=3
result=transform(inp)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in result))
